feature_name: HTTP Scheme Extractor for Axum Integration
description: Create a new HTTP scheme extractor module for the ak-axum package that allows handlers to determine whether a request was made via HTTP or HTTPS. This extractor should integrate with the existing axum router and tracing infrastructure to provide request scheme information to application handlers.
functional_requirements: Implement a Scheme extractor struct that can be used as a parameter in axum handlers to retrieve the request scheme
Integrate the scheme extractor with the existing router setup to make it available to all handlers
Ensure the extractor properly handles both HTTP and HTTPS schemes based on request headers and connection information
Add appropriate tracing and logging for scheme extraction to maintain observability
Update package dependencies and module exports to include the new scheme extractor functionality
